integrity: Theorem proof is analytical; finite standard-library verification is corroborative. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proves the first three local spectral crossings of a specified equal-weight commensurate two-delay equation and one type-2 macroscopic equilibrium. It does not classify all later delays, nonlinear Hopf type, global dynamics, unequal weights, or robustness. The closest 2024 two-commensurate-delay full paper was inaccessible; historical priority needs further review.
title: Two-tap synaptic memory forces a universal restabilization window
